label: Micro-Fauna Processing Loop
description: The logical sequence of moving a small fauna specimen from chemical stabilization to microscopic matrix removal.

steps.objective: Reveal the fossilized bone from the surrounding rock under 10x magnification.
Apply the prepared B-72 to micro-fractures identified under magnification.

game_mechanics.magnification_toggle: Player clicks the microscope to enter 'Micro-Mode' where mouse sensitivity is lowered for precision clicking.
game_mechanics.chemical_freshness: The B-72 mixed in the hood has a 'shelf life' before it becomes too gummy to wick properly.
